topic: The accidental improvised scene that became the most iconic moment in cinema
hook: He improvised it by accident. It became cinema's most iconic scene.
script: He improvised it by accident. It became cinema's most iconic scene. In The Godfather, Marlon Brando's cat was not in the script. It wandered onto set during filming. Brando picked it up and continued acting. The purring muffled some of his dialogue. Coppola kept it. The image of a crime lord gently stroking a cat became the defining visual of an entire film genre. Follow for accidental moments that became movie history.
